phases.message: I'm Dana Whitcombe. This is my mail: the plan's notice and invoices for my children's care. Read every message. Don't do anything yet: I'll send you to my bank, my insurer, my pharmacy and the plan.
This is my bank, Ledgerwren. Read its note and my statement. Don't do anything yet.
This is my health plan's member portal, Paylance. Read my explanations of benefits, every page. Don't do anything yet.
This is my pharmacy, Fennimoor. Read my receipts. Don't do anything yet.

This is Flexwell, my FSA. Read its rules, my claims and my card. Claim every eligible expense with the statement the plan asks for, answer the pending card swipe, and leave out what the plan does not cover. Then tell me what you claimed, what you left out and why.

plan.text: Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Flexwell is the administrator of Dana Whitcombe's employer's flexible spending accounts. Plan year 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026; her coverage began 1 September 2025. Topics: period, eligible, substantiation, limits, deadlines. Her claims are in read_claims and her card in read_card.

Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. An expense is incurred when the care is given, not when it is billed or paid. It counts only if it is incurred inside the period of coverage: 1 September 2025 to 30 June 2026 for Dana. This plan has no grace period. It carries over up to 660 dollars of unused health FSA money; a plan cannot offer both a grace period and a carryover for the same plan year. Dependent care has no carryover.

Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Health FSA: medical care under section 213(d), including over-the-counter drugs without a prescription and menstrual care products; not a cosmetic procedure such as teeth whitening, not a gym membership, not vitamins taken for general health, and not insurance premiums. Dependent care: care of a child under 13 so you can work. A day camp counts and an overnight camp does not. Care paid to your own child under 19, or to a dependent of yours, does not count.

Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Every claim needs a statement from someone other than you or your family, giving the date, a description and the amount; you cannot vouch for your own claim. An insurer's explanation of benefits counts, and only what you owe can be claimed, never the insurer's share. A card swipe that matches a copay or passes the item check is approved automatically. Any other swipe is pending until you send such a statement, and is repaid if you do not.

Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Health FSA: Dana elected 2,400 dollars; the federal limit for a plan year beginning in 2025 is 3,300 dollars. Dependent care: Dana elected 4,000 dollars; this plan's limit is 5,000 dollars a year. A federal limit of 7,500 dollars applies to taxable years beginning after 31 December 2025, and this plan has not adopted it.

Flexwell (invented). Today is Friday 9 October 2026. The plan year ended 30 June 2026. The run-out is the plan's own: claims for expenses incurred in the plan year must be received by 31 October 2026. Documents for a pending card swipe are due 30 days after the request.
